title: ASCII-only invariant for draw_text_c-fed strings is comment-documented but has no automated pin; the mojibake class can regress and re-bless silently
detail: The mojibake class passed r1 review — corrupted glyphs were blessed into T2 captures unnoticed. The ASCII invariant is comment-only: no test or lint gate rejects non-ASCII in draw_text_c-fed strings, so the class can regress and re-bless silently.
recommended_fix: Add a lint gate (tools/lint.sh) asserting the draw_text_c-fed format strings and catalog display strings are pure ASCII, so a non-ASCII rune fails CI before any T2 re-bless.
